claim: Current canonical field sheet has 754 workbook rows but only 733 unique valid table-field keys.
limitation: Counts describe current workbook structure, not approved target fields.

claim: Seventeen logical field keys are duplicated and one populated field lacks table identity.
limitation: Duplicate rows may encode round variants; audit does not auto-merge them.

claim: Current schema generator omits courageous_camel_2024 despite 324 field rows carrying that round.
limitation: Round flags do not prove fields are populated in released data.

claim: Published extraction model retains 750 field entries over 733 unique keys and includes no unit field.
limitation: Published model derives from v2026.1 source and is not rebuilt from current workbook in this review.

claim: Only 42 of 83 lookup table-field pairs exactly match current field-registry keys.
limitation: Unmatched pairs may be stale names, source omissions, or intentional external tables; no candidate is auto-approved.

claim: Unit crosswalk has 64 blank corrections and one raw label with two distinct nonblank corrections.
limitation: Audit evaluates labels only and does not infer dimensions or conversion factors.

claim: Published agronomy and livestock product schemas each contain 138 columns and zero descriptions.
limitation: Schema files describe released product columns but do not prove data values satisfy intended semantics.

claim: eragri package data has 137 columns while package dictionary has 106 field names.
limitation: Package snapshot may intentionally represent an older release; missing provenance prevents automatic reconciliation.

claim: Current approved semantic bindings cover 13 livestock/feed or grazing concepts and no crop source fields.
limitation: Generic target classes do not establish shared-core scope.

claim: Current approved semantic value contract contains 298 livestock/feed-scoped rows.
limitation: Reviewed value bindings cover only observed livestock contract values.

claim: Published vocab v2026.1 records an older workbook fingerprint than current canonical workbook.
limitation: Different fingerprint signals lineage drift, not that immutable v2026.1 should be overwritten.

claim: CSVW and Frictionless Table Schema can represent field datatypes, constraints, and key relationships.
limitation: Neither standard decides agricultural semantics or ontology identity.

claim: QUDT can identify units and quantity kinds but label matching alone cannot authorize a mapping or conversion.
limitation: QUDT coverage varies by unit type; currencies and contextual ratios may require other authorities or ERA mappings.

claim: Shared-core promotion requires crop-livestock evidence; current generic scaffolds remain candidates, not completed core migration.
limitation: No semantic entity is promoted or moved by this recommendation-only review.
